note: The bytes were obtained in this run, and hashed. The investigating environment has no general network egress and no PDF tooling; the fetch and the text extraction were therefore performed by a throwaway GitHub Actions job on a temporary workflow file added to this branch for exactly that purpose (removed again in the same work item). The job fetched with curl, hashed the file, and ran `pdftotext -layout` (poppler) — the committed page extracts are that output, unedited apart from the provenance header.
